## Summary
In-plant Impressions trade-press coverage of Arizona State University's Print & Imaging Lab going live with Catfish (Infigo) + Avanti SlingShot MIS. Useful third-party data point for in-plant / education vertical deployments — and demonstrates Infigo paired with Avanti (not just Tharstern/PrintIQ).

## Key takeaways
- **Stack:** Catfish W2P + Avanti SlingShot MIS. Customers submit/compose files through Catfish; SlingShot handles estimating, imposition, and other production steps in a single touch-free sequence.
- **Outcome quote (Chris Myers, Director, ASU Print & Imaging Lab):** "We can allow the alumni and our students, faculty and staff to be able to order things like dye sublimation pieces, luggage tags, to be able to do photo books. There's a whole plethora of things that we can offer to the university that we couldn't ever do before."
- **Business model:** The lab self-funds through web-to-print revenue. Useful precedent for any in-plant or institutional Infigo deployment justification.
- **Lesson for our shop:** Infigo is not exclusive to Tharstern / printIQ — Avanti SlingShot is a documented third MIS path. If our shop ever evaluates an Avanti migration, the API surface is there.
